links.outcome: Adequacy and clarity of LLM patient medication instructions with vs without RAG on leaflets
links.effect: RAG improved adequacy: median (IQR) 93.0 (40.0) vs 94 (53.3) vs 100 (15.0), p=0.001; clarity 90.0 (60.0) vs 92 (55.0) vs 95.0 (24.0), p=0.012 for model1, model2, model3.
links.quote: RAG introduction significantly improved instructions adequacy: median (interquartile range) 93.0 (40.0) vs. 94 (53.3) vs 100 (15.0), p = 0.001, and clarity 90.0 (60.0) vs. 92 (55.0) vs 95.0 (24.0), p = 0.012, for model1, model2, model3 respectively.

unlisted_practices: Structured prompt engineering to prevent vague and unsolicited instructions in patient medication instructions
